authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/yamaha/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/yamaha/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the data list's MIDI parameter change tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Parameter change: F0 43 1n 7F 1C 09 <address> <data> F7, n the device number (the deviceId variable is 1n, 10H for device number 1); bulk dumps are asked for with 2n and answered with 0n, both taken as device number 1.
Identity: the reply the data list prints, F0 7E 7F 06 02 43 00 41 5C 06 00 00 00 7F F7.

The bulk dump table prints the Live Set Sound Common as 1 byte (46 00 00), the owner's manual's too, where its parameter change table runs to 46 00 40: those settings are not read back, and a Common block of another size is let pass.

Rows the data list prints without an address, taken as the row's before them past its size: PARAMETER CHANGE TABLE: Soundmondo Format Version Minor (00 7F 01), PARAMETER CHANGE TABLE: Soundmondo Format Version Bugfix (00 7F 02).
Left out, a value over 2 bytes split in a way not read: Live Set Sound Common: Tempo (46 00 13).

Left out, a data range in parts its description does not match: Live Set Sound Common: Modulation Lever Assign (46 00 19): 00 – 3F, 41, 43 – 77 / Off, 1 – 63, 65, 67 – 119, 120 (USB Audio Volume), Live Set Sound Common: Effect Type (46 00 2B): 00 – 15, 17 – 1F, 21 – 25 / *1, Key A: Effect 1 Type (60 00 2E): 00 – 14, 16 – 17, 19 – 25 / *3, Key A: Effect 2 Type (60 00 32): 00 – 14, 16 – 17, 19 – 25 / *3, Key B: Effect 1 Type (60 01 2E): 00 – 14, 16 – 17, 19 – 25 / *3, Key B: Effect 2 Type (60 01 32): 00 – 14, 16 – 17, 19 – 25 / *3.

Left out, several settings packed in one byte, a bit each: Zone 1: Transmit Bank Select Transmit Program Change Transmit Volume Transmit Pan Transmit Note (4A 00 0C), Zone 1: Transmit PB Transmit Mod Transmit FC1 Transmit FC2 Transmit FS Transmit Sus (4A 00 0D), Zone 2: Transmit Bank Select Transmit Program Change Transmit Volume Transmit Pan Transmit Note (4A 01 0C), Zone 2: Transmit PB Transmit Mod Transmit FC1 Transmit FC2 Transmit FS Transmit Sus (4A 01 0D), Zone 3: Transmit Bank Select Transmit Program Change Transmit Volume Transmit Pan Transmit Note (4A 02 0C), Zone 3: Transmit PB Transmit Mod Transmit FC1 Transmit FC2 Transmit FS Transmit Sus (4A 02 0D), Zone 4: Transmit Bank Select Transmit Program Change Transmit Volume Transmit Pan Transmit Note (4A 03 0C), Zone 4: Transmit PB Transmit Mod Transmit FC1 Transmit FC2 Transmit FS Transmit Sus (4A 03 0D).

Pull: Bulk dump request (System); Bulk dump request (Master EQ); Bulk dump request (Current Sound Buffer). 224 of 272 parameters are read back; not in any block: 48 parameters, in Live Set Sound Common.

parameters.description: 4 bytes: 1st bit 3-0: bit 15-12 2nd bit 3-0: bit 11-8 3rd bit 3-0: bit 7-4 4th bit 3-0: bit 3-0. Printed: 414.72 – 466.78 [Hz].

parameters.description: 15 characters, one per address from 46 00 00, 32 – 127 (ASCII). Read from the bulk dump; not written, since a parameter change carries one character.
